products.title: The Aoki Back Attack System by Shinya Aoki
products.body:
MMA Legend and ADCC Vet Shinya Aoki Breaks Down His Surefire System Of Attacking The Back!

  • Master key back control concepts to keep your opponent immobilized while you set up your submissions.
  • Use Aoki’s battle tested techniques to break through your opponent’s defense on your way to securing multiple choke variations from the back.
  • Attack the turtle with precise controls, and slick back takes that Shinya has refined over his successful career.
  • Stay steps ahead of your opponent when they attempt to escape back control with Shinya’s arm triangle arsenal.
  • Develop world-class back control, submissions, transitions, and MORE with Shinya Aoki!


The Aoki Back Attack System Contains 3 Distinct Sections That Combine Into A Complete System Of Attack From MMA Legend Shinya Aoki!


Check out a free sample:


What Will You Learn?


The ability to finish from back control is a necessity that EVERY grappler should master. Shinya Aoki looks to provide a clear-cut system of successfully attacking the back in his first instructional for BJJFanatics! Whether you are just starting out or looking to gain an edge over the competition at the next tournament, becoming a master of attacking the back is a strong strategy. 


On top of earning 29 submission victories in his MMA career, Shinya has also competed in top-tier grappling competitions like ADCC, so it’s safe to say he knows a thing or two about securing fight-ending finishes. Shinya Aoki has had many stellar submissions from the back in his MMA and BJJ career. His instructional, The Aoki Back Attack System is a 3-part series that focuses on all aspects of back attacks including controls, transitions, back takes, and of course submissions!


 

Shinya emphasizes using unique controls from the back that don’t require immense strength to secure. By learning his methods of control you can buy yourself enough time to work your way to a wide array of finishes. Another section is dedicated to opening your opponent’s pesky defensive strategies including tucking the chin. Shinya sheds light on how to crack through these defenses, and punish any opponent that decides to tuck their chin!


 

As an added bonus Aoki gives an inside look at attacking the turtle, and staying ready for any escape attempts. Shinya breaks down how he sets traps for his opponent’s by letting them escape back control only to find themselves in a super tight arm triangle! The Aoki Back Attack System cuts out the guesswork of successfully attacking the back with legendary details from Shinya Aoki!




So What’s On This Series?


PART 1

  • INTRODUCTION
  • BACK CONTROL: SEAT BELT
  • BACK CONTROL: HOW TO CLUTCH
  • BACK CONTROL: OPENING UP THE NECK TO PLACE HAND
  • BACK CONTROL: FINISH THE CHOKE
  • PALM-TO-PALM CHOKE: PART 1
  • PALM-TO-PALM CHOKE: PART 2
  • BACK CONTROL: SPECIAL CHOKE
  • ADDITIONAL DETAILS FOR #4: OPENING UP THE NECK
  • HOW TO CONTROL DEFENDING HAND FOR ARM LOCK
  • BACK CHOKE: WHEN OPPONENT USES CHIN-DOWN DEFENSE

PART 2

  • NECK CRANK
  • HOW TO CONTROL THE TURTLE POSITION: PART 1, POSITION
  • HOW TO CONTROL THE TURTLE POSITION: PART 2, BODY LOCK
  • HOW TO CONTROL THE TURTLE POSITION: PART 3, BACK CONTROL
  • HOW TO TAKE WRIST CONTROL
  • WRIST CONTROL TO NELSON

PART 3

  • TURTLE POSITION TO ARM TRIANGLE
  • HOW TO FINISH THE ARM TRIANGLE, HAND CLUTCH: PART 1
  • HOW TO FINISH THE ARM TRIANGLE, HAND CLUTCH: PART 2
  • FINISHING THE ARM TRIANGLE
  • ARM TRIANGLE FROM HALF GUARD
  • SHOULDER PRESSURE FROM HALF-GUARD
  • SHOULDER PRESSURE TO ARM TRIANGLE
  • VON FLUE CHOKE FROM SIDE CONTROL

products.title: The Aoki Arm Bar System by Shinya Aoki
products.body:
MMA Legend Shinya Aoki Shares His Lighting Fast Armbar System That Leaves No Time For Escape!

  • Learn a wide array of armbar attacks that range from flying armbars, to more basic setups form the mount.
  • Transition from standing position directly to armbars with Shinya’s guard pull armbars that give you a consistent method of taking the fight to the ground.
  • Master the spinning armbar to avoid your opponent's stack defense.
  • Locked hands? No problem with Shinya’s surefire methods of defeating even the best grips.
  • Attack overly defensive opponents with one of Aoki’s favorite chokes the tsukkomi-jime !


The Aoki Armbar System Is A 3-Part Series Where Shinya Aoki Shares His Favorite Armbar Setups, Attacks, And Methods To Defeat Your Opponent’s Best Defensive Efforts!

Check out a free sample:


What Will You Learn?


The armbar is a classic technique in the world of combat, and has been proven to work at the highest levels of multiple sports like BJJ, Judo, and MMA. Shinya Aoki is an MMA legend that has made a career out of landing fight finishing armbars. The Aoki Armbar System is a 3-part series where Shinya breaks down his favorite methods of securing a wide range of armbars spanning numerous positions.


Shinya Aoki is an MMA legend that also competed in high level grappling events such as ADCC. He is a black belt in both Judo and BJJ. This unique experience has helped him develop explosive armbar attacks with precise finishing methods that leave no option of escape. Aoki looks to simplify techniques that seem flashy and complex. Techniques like the flying armbar are often feared for their seemingly complex nature. Aoki puts his teaching skills on display by teaching you how to safely apply one of his go to setups for landing the armbar. 


 

While the armbar can be applied from a wide range of positions, one unique aspect of this instructional is Aoki’s focus on the ability to apply armbars from the standing position. This comes in the form of flying armbars, but also guard pulls that transition directly into spinning armbars. Any grappler can make use of these quick hitting attacks that are hard to see coming, and even harder to defend.


Once your training partners start to realize how good you've gotten at armbars that they may become overly defensive. This is where Aoki sheds light on one of his go-to gi attacks with the tsukkomi-jime choke. While your opponent is concerned with his arms, you’ll have the opportunity to apply this BRUTAL strangle! Develop a complete system of attack revolving around Shinya Aoki’s armbar system!

So What’s On This Series?


PART 1

  • INTRODUCTION
  • FLYING ARMBAR
  • SPINNING ARMBAR- SAME SIDE
  • SPINNING ARMBAR- OPPOSITE SIDE

PART 2

  • ARMBAR
  • ARMBAR-HOW TO STRIP THE ARMBAR DEFENSE, PART 1
  • ARMBAR-HOW TO STRIP THE ARMBAR DEFENSE, PART 2
  • ARMBAR-HOW TO STRIP THE ARMBAR DEFENSE, PART 3

PART 3

  • ARMBAR- MOUNT POSITION
  • ARMBAR- FROM TOP TURTLE POSITION
  • WAKI-GATAME ARMLOCK- SAME SIDE
  • WAKI-GATAME ARMLOCK- OPPOSITE SIDE
  • WAKI-GATAME ARMLOCK- OVERHOOK GRIP
  • TSUKKOMI-JIME CHOKE
  • TSUKKOMI-JIME CHOKE- FROM HALF GUARD
  • TSUKKOMI-JIME CHOKE- FROM TOP TURTLE
  • CROSS CHOKE

So What Does It Cost?

$97

products.title: Systematically Attacking The Guard 2.0 by Gordon Ryan
products.body:
Attack The Guard In A Whole New Way With Gordon “The King” Ryan’s System For Passing That Gordon Calls “The Real Way To Pass Good Guards” - Including His Secret High Stepping Method That He’s Been Crushing The Competition With! 

  • Gordon “The King” Ryan is a multiple-time ADCC champion who is the most dominant and technical no-gi grappler on Earth, and this is your chance to learn his incredibly effective loose passing system!
  • Combine your techniques to be able to move through stubborn guards, including specific positions like Reverse De La Riva, De La Riva, ashi garami, and more
  • Hear Gordon’s methodology and advice on how to use this system to revolutionize your guard passing, including his new philosophy for you to work by
  • See why the flanking position is so powerful and how you can weaponize the j point at all-times as you force your way around and through the guard
  • See actual rolling footage from the gym as Gordon puts this system into action and then breaks down exactly what he was doing so you can see the techniques in motion                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     

Attack The Guard In A Whole New Way With Gordon “The King” Ryan’s System For Passing That Gordon Calls “The Real Way To Pass Good Guards” - Including His Secret High Stepping Method That He’s Been Crushing The Competition With!

Check Out Sample!

What Will You Learn?

Change the whole way you approach guard passing with Gordon Ryan’s guide to using loose passing to create a system that lets you put constant pressure on the opposition. Over 8-volumes, Gordon breaks down his entire arsenal of toreandos, high step passes, flanking passes, and more that he combines into a system that anyone can use to upgrade their top game.

Gordon has been tearing up the competition with his methods for high stepping through and toreando passing around the guard, making his opponents constantly work until he breaks down their defenses and takes total control. Now you can learn all of those techniques, strategies, central problems, and more as Gordon breaks down everything you’ll need to know.

Watch these systems in action as Gordon rolls live in the gym and then breaks down each roll - for you to see what he’s doing and hear why he’s doing it. Work with the most upgraded and modern no-gi passing as Gordon shows you how to pummel and pass from De La Riva, ashi garami, reverse De La Riva, and more - and why you must use the flanking position as often as possible for your best passing results.

Don’t miss this chance to get an entirely new outlook on your guard passing with this series on how to turn loose passing into real pressure. With this new philosophy, grapplers of all levels can keep people off their legs longer, stay on offense, and create reliable passes that change their whole game for the better.

products.title: Standing2Ground Bundle by John Danaher
products.body:
Develop A Complete System From The Standing Position With The Standing2Ground Bundle From One Of The Greatest Minds In Grappling John Danaher!

  • World-Class coach and instructor John Danaher presents his Standing2Ground system that focuses on positional dominance, scrimmage wrestling, as well as upper and lower body takedowns!
  • Make takedowns easier than ever by building towards consistently advantageous positions with superior grip fighting and off-balancing techniques.
  • Use highly effective techniques like the arm drag, throw by, duck under, and more to create back exposure and get dominant back takes from the feet.
  • Defend your opponent’s attacks with John’s special studies on limp legs, standing submission offense, the sprawl, and more!
  • Use snap downs, hand fighting, and motion to set up takedowns that will optimize your chances of scoring and controlling from top position.
  • Modify and adapt your takedown skills to perfectly suit today’s modern approach from the start of every match!
  • Know More. Win More.
